bites.title: Value is light and dark
bites.body:
Value is how light or dark something is. 0% is black, 100% is white paper. The top row is the answer key. The bottom boxes are yours.

This time: build darkness by stacking see-through strokes, like layers of graphite.

bites.title: The dark end
bites.body: Fill boxes 1, 2 and 3 (0%, 11%, 22%) by stroking over and over with the 15% brush. Box 1 needs a lot of passes.

bites.title: The whole ladder
bites.body: Now all ten. Box 10 is the paper itself: leave it alone.

bites.title: 10 cleared
bites.body: Darkness by layering. Same idea as graphite, charcoal, or ink washes.
